governing_rules: Do not recreate Catholic Life as an umbrella module.
One concern has one canonical owner; other surfaces hand off explicitly.
A new Formation route requires a coherent learning objective, substantial source substrate, and material that cannot be served better by existing owners.

Prayer execution belongs to PRAY; liturgical execution belongs to Mass; temporal logic belongs to Calendar; local/customary practice belongs to Customary/Explore; Formation explains and teaches without duplicating those engines.
Unsourced pastoral synthesis is research-only until explicit authority is attached.

rationale: This is a genuine learning domain rather than an orchestration wrapper.

Substantial prior project research already exists on mental prayer, particular and general examen, spiritual reading, presence of God, sanctification of ordinary duties, and a flexible rule/plan of life.
The recovered research substrate includes Tanquerey, Chautard, St Francis de Sales and Saint-Sulpice-style mental-prayer material, but it is not yet normalized into one source-controlled corpus.
The Catholic Life salvage contributes only a small residue; the strand must be rebuilt from the larger traditional spiritual-formation research rather than from those cards.
canonical_scope: call to holiness and purpose of the interior life
mental prayer: what it is, how to begin, common difficulties
vocal prayer in relation to mental prayer
general and particular examination of conscience
spiritual reading: purpose, method and selection
rule/plan of life: stable core without rigidity or gamification
sanctification of ordinary duties, work and state in life
distractions, dryness, perseverance and prudent adaptation
indulgences and reparation as doctrinally grounded practices rather than a points economy
explicit_non_owners: PRAY owns actual prayer texts, Rosary, Morning/Evening Prayer, Adoration, First Friday and other devotional execution.
Calendar owns dates, seasons and temporal obligations.
Apostolate owns helping or teaching another person.
The strand must not act as a substitute spiritual director or create behavioural scoring, streaks or gamified holiness.
publication_gates: Recover and normalize the larger traditional source corpus before writing the course.
Every explanatory claim must carry explicit provenance.
English/French parity is required at publication.
Separate universal doctrine, traditional counsel, school-specific method and prudential app guidance.
Do not ship merely because the reserved route exists.

rationale: The user need is orchestration, not another course.

Apostolate already contains eight sourced bilingual Family Help scenarios covering family Rosary, grace, morning/evening prayer, teaching children prayers, First Confession/Communion preparation, godparents, Confirmation sponsors and Sacred Heart devotion.
Actual actions already have canonical owners in PRAY and the sacramental Formation modules.
Domestic/customary practices are better surfaced contextually through Calendar and Customary data.
catholic_home_and_family.residual_action: Merge the three Catholic Life residual claims into Matrimony aftercare / Apostolate Family Help where useful; do not create learn.catholic_home.

rationale: The traditional Requiem and funeral Absolution already have certified Mass runtime ownership.
Serious Illness & Dying is the natural Formation owner for what happens before death and the immediate after-death/funeral handoff.
Prayer for the dead and dying already belongs to PRAY/Holy Souls/Dying Companion.
A second Funeral/Requiem course would duplicate the rite, the dying guide and the prayer treasury.
funeral_and_requiem.residual_action: Extend the Serious Illness & Dying owner with a sourced after-death/funeral section for funeral forms, Requiem orientation, burial/cremation/ashes distinctions and explicit handoffs to Mass/PRAY. Do not create a new route.

rationale: Only seven residual claims exist and four are unsourced.
The recovered project history does not show a substantial independent research corpus comparable to Spiritual Life.
Religious profession is not Holy Orders, so forcing the subject into learn.rites.holy_orders would create a category error.
religious_life.residual_action: Keep canonical distinctions as reference research. Revisit only as part of a source-complete States of Life/Vocation study; no launcher now.

rationale: Only seven residual claims exist and six are unsourced.
Existing sacramental owners already cover concrete preparation for Holy Orders and Matrimony.
Generic discernment advice is too easy to turn into unsourced pastoral synthesis or pseudo-spiritual-direction.
vocations.residual_action: Preserve the research. If later work justifies it, Religious Life and Vocations may converge into one source-complete States of Life & Vocation Formation strand; neither gets a route now.

immediate_actions: Spiritual Life is now the published focused Formation strand; preserve its owner boundaries and source-controlled curriculum.
Fold Funeral/Requiem explanatory residue into Serious Illness & Dying plus existing Mass/PRAY handoffs.
Use Apostolate Family Help and contextual owners for Catholic Home & Family rather than adding a Formation card.
Leave Religious Life and Vocations research-only.
Reject any reintroduction of learn.catholic_life as a valid handoff or Formation route.
